name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and grip a barbell shoulder-width apart in front of your thighs with palms facing forward.
Pin your elbows close to your ribs and brace your core tightly.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders by flexing strictly at the elbows.
Pause briefly to squeeze your biceps, then lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension.
tips: Keep your hips and torso still rather than swinging the weight upward.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid curling them inward at the top.
